C-71.Name: Table centering, discoverable viewer zoom and readable tooltips
C-71.Summary: Fix the three defects reported by the owner on 2026-10-19. The owner clarified that the missing viewer tool means zoom in/out. Existing table, viewer and tooltip contracts remain the behavior baseline.

Goals.R-1: Expanded tables center within available editor space, track window/sidebar/font changes, and retain reachable horizontal overflow for oversized content.
Goals.R-2: Viewer zoom in/out and fit controls remain visible, labeled and clickable at supported window sizes.
Goals.R-3: All shipped short image/tooltips fit on one readable line; exceptionally long tooltips remain bounded and readable.

Constraints.Item: No new release/tag or release publication; preserve the owner's working trees and documents.
Reproduce geometry in Chromium and WebKit. Keep thresholds intact.

NonGoals.Item: No change to Markdown, table persistence identity or export formats.
Whole-product coverage completion is tracked separately by C-72.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Regression tests fail on the reported layout faults and pass after the fixes in both engines; unit tests, build and GRACE checks pass.

AffectedAreas.Item: M-012 table layout, resize events, fullscreen viewer, image/general tooltip styles and tests.
